steps.rationale: The goal specifies the book is in the Science category; the sidebar category link filters the catalogue to Science titles.
Title link for 'The Grand Design' within the Science listing — opens the product detail page which carries the tax-inclusive price and stock count.

checkpoint.description: Navigated Home → Science category → 'The Grand Design' product page and read its Product Information table. Price (incl. tax) is £13.76 (tax £0.00, so equal to the excl. tax price) and availability is 'In stock (5 available)'. Both values were recorded via row-label anchors ('Price (incl. tax)' and 'Availability'), so replay can relocate them even if the amounts or counts change. Checkpoint is the stable 'Product Information' heading on the detail page.
